exact_target: For independent standard Gaussian weights g_v on Z_+^2, let M_n=max_p sum_{v in p}g_v over all n-vertex up/right paths starting at (0,0), with endpoint free. Improve Chatterjee's Var(M_n)<=C n/log n to Var(M_n)<=C_epsilon n^(1-epsilon) for some epsilon>0 independent of n>=2. This is the concrete power-improvement formulation of Section 12(3) in the Section 8 model. The general-dimensional fixed-temperature log Z_n problem is a separate related formulation, supported for nearly gamma disorder by Alexander-Zygouras arXiv:1204.1819; it is not the observable in the cited Chatterjee theorem. Current openness is UNKNOWN.
